d:
Freedom is precious. Freedom is personal. Freedom is fragile.
Our love for our country cannot be explained in words. We feel it inside when we travel and see its diversity. From Kashmir to Kanyakumari, from Kutch to Kamjong, we feel it in the soil, the mountains, the rivers, the jungles, the deserts, the oceans and in the people. We feel it when we travel outside the country and we miss home.
